results.statement: atm-task-close.py must proceed with local git checks when GitHub is unreachable or rate limited, recording that in its result, and must offer a --skip-checks flag that bypasses the PR and stack checks, described only in the script's --help as requiring the phase lead's permission and named in no template or prompt.
results.quote: if we rate limit, we need to proceed.  we can't afford to stop due to rate limiting.  we should also provide a 'backdoor' flag the dev can use to get around checks WHEN given permissions.  i.e. --skip-checks.  --skip-checks wouldn't be in the templates or prompt prose, but could be discovered through help on the python script the dev is calling w/ description 'skips pr,.., checks. Do NOT use without permission from <lead>'  (or similar).
results.context: phase-bj planning 2026-10-18: Rand's close-hook and mechanical-assignment rulings (atm-core #1873 comment 1, atm-bd-orchestration #340, PR #342)
